This update brings several performance improvements, bug fixes, and quality-of-life enhancements to BMX Streets, including new bike customization options and easier access to multiplayer sessions.
Multiplayer Browser: Added a dedicated Multiplayer button to the main menu, allowing players to quickly browse and join multiplayer sessions.
Bike Configuration: Added a new configuration menu within Bike Customization, allowing players to adjust drive side, seat height, and handlebar angle.
Performance Optimizations: Implemented several performance improvements to enhance gameplay smoothness and stability.
Character Hair: Fixed an issue causing character hair to appear white.
Bike Anchor Points: Fixed several issues with anchor points incorrectly snapping to positions on the bike.
Mod.io Content: Applied minor fixes to improve content loading reliability.
Replay Editor: Fixed several minor issues within the Replay Editor.
Multiplayer Replays: Player gamertags are now hidden during replay playback for a cleaner viewing experience.
General Improvements: Additional minor bug fixes and polish throughout the game.
Thanks for continuing to play and support BMX Streets! We're constantly working to improve performance, polish existing systems, and make the overall experience better.

Version 2.0 Alpha Now Live!

We’ve completely rebuilt the game from the ground up based on community feedback following the 1.0 launch. This update marks the beginning of a brand new era for the game — faster, smoother, and more refined across the board.
Full overhaul of core systems and gameplay
Improved visuals, UI, and performance
New mechanics and design improvements throughout
More responsive controls and streamlined interactions
2.0 Alpha (Default): The new version, rebuilt from scratch
1.0 Vanilla: The original launch version, still available on a Steam beta branch
Right-click the game in your Steam Library and choose Properties
Go to the Betas tab
Select the "1.0 Vanilla" branch
We're still actively developing 2.0, but it's already a big leap forward. Your feedback is more important than ever — thank you for being part of this journey!
